{{Quote|The ''Resolute''{{'s}} main action was picking off cruisers too heavily damaged to put up a fair fight.|Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>}}
'''''Resolute''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|service]] of the [[Fel Empire]] in [[130 ABY]]. Under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Edouard Fenel]] it participated in the [[Battle of Caamas]], the final battle of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], where it destroyed a number of cruisers too heavily damaged to properly defend themselves. [[137 ABY|Seven years later]], [[Gar Stazi]] sarcastically commented ''Resolute''{{'s}} role in battle during a conversation with Fenel.
